decisions.quote: Taken in context, the early onset of tumors in the control groups of this replication attempt effectively masks any potential effect of the PREX2 mutations being examined. The median TFS of all groups, especially the GFP and PREX2WT melanocyte injected mice, were dramatically shorter than what was reported in the original study and what was anticipated in the design of this replication study (Figure 3—figure supplement 1).
decisions.location: Results and discussion (Generation of tumor xenografts expressing PREX2 isoforms and evaluation of tumor-free survival and tumor growth)
decisions.reason: Although no statistically significant difference in tumor-free survival was observed between PREX2 variants and controls, the authors explicitly conclude that the unexpectedly rapid 1-week tumor onset in the control groups 'effectively masks any potential effect of the PREX2 mutations being examined' and 'makes the detection of accelerated tumor growth in PREX2 expressing NRASG12D melanocytes extremely difficult' (and note in the author response that 'the failure to replicate is compromised by this finding'). Under the codebook, when the authors' substantive verdict is that a defect or limitation of the attempt prevents a meaningful test of the original claim, the outcome is 'uninformative' rather than 'failed'.
